mapper.select: select id, record_id, user_id, reason_type, content, status, handle_result, handled_by, handle_time, create_time from t_appeal where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into t_appeal(record_id, user_id, reason_type, content, status, handle_result, handled_by, handle_time, create_time) values(#{recordId}, #{userId}, #{reasonType}, #{content}, #{status}, #{handleResult}, #{handledBy}, #{handleTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update t_appeal set status = #{newStatus}, handle_result = #{handleResult}, handled_by = #{handledBy}, handle_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0
